chunks: Then Pharaoh sent announcers to the cities,
ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh send out to the cities?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse illustrates Pharaoh's centralized bureaucratic power as he mobilizes his kingdom to gather the people for the contest of magicians. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a display of tyrannical arrogance, where the ruler uses administrative force to legitimize his claim to divinity against the prophets.
